edges.method: handlebars pin held in clip of clip tile (eyebrow)

ball.1 of 14417 into socket.1 of 14419 (knee, leg 1)
ball.1 of 14419 into socket.1 of 14704 (hip, leg 1)
plate underside clutches inverted slope studs (added from below, leg 2 step 3)
ball.1 of 14417 into socket.1 of 14419 (knee, leg 2)

flame bar attached at the back of the 11211 side studs (assumed)
flame bar attached at the back of the 11211 side studs (assumed)

notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 45 pieces over 26 lines.
The leg sub-assembly (pages 10-13) is built twice, as b32-b37 and b38-b43. It is shown in the booklet before steps 17 and 18, but listed after step 16 here.
Some steps (6, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16) show pieces being added without a callout. I inferred which pieces they are and how they stack from the pictures and the parts list.
The curved 11477 on each arm covers the clip plate and the hinge plate. rests_on records both.

The booklet does not clearly show where the eyes mount. I assumed each eye sits on the stud of a dark red jumper plate. The light grey 14704 socket plates are used as the hips for the legs' ball joints.
The booklet does not show how the flames attach in step 19. I assumed they attach at the back of the 11211 brick.
The 3665 foot slope is added from below the 14417 plate, so the link is recorded in other_joins. The plate is placed first, so its rests_on stays empty.
position is left null as requested.
